step_name: markdown research journal auto exposure dashboard design

research_wiki_jsx.risk: Label is too narrow for general research journals; category can be reused but should be relabeled to Research Logs or Recent Logs.

research_records_panel.purpose: campaign evidence summary/jsonl/log cards, not markdown journal browsing

implementation_design.goal: Automatically expose recent docs/update_log/*.md research journals in the dashboard Research Wiki without manually editing _SELECTED_UPDATE_LOGS for every session.
backend_patch: Add _iter_recent_update_logs() that scans REPO_ROOT / docs/update_log for YYYY-MM-DD_*.md files, sorted by mtime desc then name desc.
In _iter_allowed_docs(), keep _DOC_ROOTS and _SELECTED_UPDATE_LOGS, then append latest update logs not already included.
Use category update_log for the dynamic rows so the existing ResearchWikiPanel grouping works.
Keep _doc_index() path normalization and /research_doc id lookup unchanged so path traversal protection remains centralized.
frontend_patch: Relabel RESEARCH_WIKI_CATEGORIES update_log from Failed Candidates to Recent Logs or Research Logs.
Optionally prefer the most recent update_log when no wiki doc exists; otherwise keep current preferred wiki behavior.
No need to change ResearchRecordsPanel because campaign records and markdown docs are different surfaces.
tests: Add a unit test for _iter_allowed_docs or research_docs that creates recent update_log markdown in a monkeypatched REPO_ROOT and asserts newest logs are present.
Add a test that _SELECTED_UPDATE_LOGS remain present even if they are older than the dynamic limit.
Add a path traversal/detail test for a non-allowed id remains unavailable.
Add a frontend source contract assertion that update_log label is Research Logs or Recent Logs.
manual_qa: Start dashboard locally and call curl -i http://127.0.0.1:<port>/research_docs; assert latest docs/update_log/2026-06-18_*.md ids appear.
Open Research Wiki, press refresh, verify update_log category lists latest research journal and document pane shows markdown text.
risk_controls: Limit latest update logs to prevent huge payloads.
Only include .md files directly under docs/update_log matching date-prefixed filenames.
Do not include protected runtime paths or screenshots.
Do not mark V3K gate docs complete; this only exposes docs already present on disk.

next_patch_plan.task: Write failing backend test for latest update_log inclusion
Patch ResearchWikiPanel category label and frontend source test
Run focused pytest and TestClient/curl manual QA

reason: The current API exposes only four selected update logs, while the Research Wiki UI already supports an update_log category. A bounded dynamic update_log index is the smallest change that makes nightly research journals visible without misusing ResearchRecordsPanel.
